{ 
    local binary="$1" expected_source="$2";
    local manifest="${binary}.manifest" recorded_sha recorded_source actual_sha;
    [[ -x "$binary" && -f "$manifest" ]] || return 1;

    [[ "$recorded_sha" == "$actual_sha" && "$recorded_source" == "$expected_source" ]]
}
